method: Read final Git-pinned Desktop snapshot and support ZIP entries.
Compare every declared source preimage with the actual cached upstream archive, including pinned dependencies.

Apply all 22 official patch files in memory and compare the resulting text with the support overlay; normalize only CRLF to LF for semantic comparison. Original and replacement SHA-256 checks use raw bytes.
Trace production write/build/copy call sites and distinguish qualification probe consumers.
Inspect actual production CMake cache for the Pinyon feature flags. No builds or game execution in this audit.

ranges.text:
# rexglue_ffx_api_headers.cmake — the FidelityFX API headers (MIT), without
# the SDK build.
#
# The FSR 2/3 provider (src/ui/vulkan/ffx_upscaler.cpp) calls the FidelityFX
# API through five entry points. Without REXGLUE_ENABLE_FIDELITYFX (the SDK
# built from source), it loads them at run time: on Windows from AMD's signed
# runtime (amd_fidelityfx_vk.dll, SDK 1.1.4), downloaded here from the same
# pinned fork commit, which carries it in PrebuiltSignedDLL/; elsewhere from
# the library thirdparty/fidelityfx-vk builds from source. The headers come
# from that commit too.
#
# Sets REXGLUE_FFX_API_INCLUDE_DIR when the headers are present, and on
# Windows REXGLUE_FFX_RUNTIME_DLL when the signed runtime is (the game
# stages it in upscalers/fidelityfx/1.1.4/, rexglue_helpers.cmake).

option(REXGLUE_FFX_API_LOADER
    "Build the FSR 2/3 provider that loads the FidelityFX runtime at run time" ON)

set(REXGLUE_FFX_API_INCLUDE_DIR "" CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(REXGLUE_FFX_RUNTIME_DLL "" CACHE INTERNAL "")
if(REXGLUE_FIDELITYFX_SOURCE_DIR)
    set(REXGLUE_FFX_API_INCLUDE_DIR "${REXGLUE_FIDELITYFX_SOURCE_DIR}/ffx-api/include"
        CACHE INTERNAL "")
    return()
endif()
if(NOT REXGLUE_FFX_API_LOADER OR NOT REXGLUE_USE_VULKAN)
    return()
endif()

#==========================================================
# rexglue_helpers.cmake
#
# Three helpers, each with a single responsibility:
#   rexglue_apply_target_settings(<target>)        - common compile/platform flags
#   rexglue_configure_target(<target>)             - host application
#   rexglue_configure_module_target(<target> ...)  - guest DLL module
#==========================================================
include_guard(GLOBAL)

option(REXGLUE_FIDELITYFX_RUNTIME
    "Stage AMD's FidelityFX library (FSR 2 and 3) beside the game: built from source on Linux and macOS, AMD's signed DLL on Windows"
    ON)

# Copies files into upscalers/<subdirectory>/ beside the executable whenever

limitations: The result classifies modifications present in the pinned integration; it is not a gameplay completeness review of each entire upstream repository.
Byte hashes and replay establish overlay provenance, not proof that the custom runtime matches upstream behavior in a commercial playthrough.
Bridge binary source correspondence was not rebuilt in this audit; source, fixed binary hashes, retained build provenance and production call sites were inspected.
Existing successful host, ABI, DLL-loader and synthetic-image tests do not establish commercial boot, real guest facade correctness or gameplay.

findings.title: Temporal FSR2/3 and FidelityFX frame generation disabled by AllFix build configuration
findings.consequence: Feature loss relative to original SDK defaults; not merely a source-compatibility patch.

findings.title: AllFix unconditionally omits experimental ReGPU renderer that the official Windows launcher normally builds
findings.consequence: The xenos runtime remains; the extra ReGPU plugin is omitted without attempting the official conditional build.

findings.title: AllFix maintains modified SDK/runtime copies and custom NGX/ETW bridges
findings.consequence: This exceeds installation-only orchestration. No added missing gameplay was found in these reviewed diffs, but runtime semantic equivalence is not established by compilation.

findings.title: Facade test DLLs are synthetic and are not the real generated guest facades
findings.consequence: The test proves entrypoint/loader/naming behavior. It cannot be used as proof that the commercial modules execute.

findings.title: Large SDL/FFmpeg and graphics/codegen patches already belong to the upstream projects
findings.consequence: Do not attribute those gameplay-adjacent engine changes to AllFix authors; the actual AllFix residual changes are separately recorded.
